text: I posted a billing review in #claude-web by mistake on day one. Nobody minded. They just pointed me to #subscriptions.
Subscriptions also owns refunds and App Store receipts. Same channel, same people. Saves you a second question.
Hi, it's me, the team you're looking for. Say hi when you get here. 👋
The asset tag sticker is on the bottom of the laptop. Yes, you have to flip it over. Everyone does.
I asked IT for the Apple Developer invite and waited a day. It's Marcus. Always Marcus. Just DM him.
IT replied to me in 4 minutes. They are fast if you give them the three things.
I nodded along in standup for two weeks before I asked what 'the train' was. Don't be me. Ask.
The train leaves Tuesday at noon Pacific. That is 8pm for Lena. Plan your Tuesdays around it.
We added the glossary because of new hire feedback. Keep telling us which words are confusing.
Your first PR should be boring. Mine fixed one word in Settings. The point is learning the flow, not impressing anyone.
Screenshot before and after, even for one word. Jun will ask for it anyway.
Post the PR link in your team channel. Someone always picks it up before lunch.
This norm exists because of me. I got talked over for a month from Mexico City. Now nobody has to.
Type 'hand' early. Marcus reads the thread in order, so the first hand goes first. London lag is real.
I used it on my second day and the host said 'Kai, go ahead' and I nearly cried. It works.
People say yes. Truly. The scariest DM you send this week will be the best 20 minutes of it.
If you're on iOS, book me first. I'll show you the design system before you ship your first screen.
Pick me if you want. I still have questions too. We can be confused together.
Asking for help at minute 31 is following the rule. Waiting until minute 90 is the only way to do this wrong.
You will shadow Lena for a month first. Nobody gets paged alone in week one. Breathe.
The runbook link is in the page itself. Do not go looking for it in the wiki at 2am like I did.
This stop scared me most. Read the on call page twice, then it is fine.
Your note goes on the map for the next person. Mine from 2023 is still on stop 1. That is the whole point.
Made it! See you on the other side. Ping me any time, seriously.
I typed and deleted my hello four times. Just post it. Marcus replies with a coffee emoji every single time.
Say where you are and what hours you keep. Half the team is remote, it helps everyone.
There is no wrong way to say hi. Welcome to the team.
Open the workspace, not the project. I lost a whole afternoon to that on day two. You will not.
Bootstrap failed for me once and worked the second time. Run it twice before you worry.
Two tests are flaky on a fresh machine. Not you. Re-run once, then ask.
